hawking.coverLine: 越过可见的边界，仍有问题等着发光
hawking.encouragement: 面对未知，不必立刻填满所有空白。
hawking.englishEncouragement: When you face the unknown, you need not fill every blank at once.

qingming.coverLine: 一卷长画，把城市的一天慢慢展开
qingming.encouragement: 把目光放慢，热闹里也能读出许多细节。
qingming.englishEncouragement: Slow your gaze, and a busy scene begins to tell many small stories.

voyager.coverLine: 把地球的声音，寄往更远的地方
voyager.encouragement: 表达不必宏大；认真说出一句，也能抵达远方。
voyager.englishEncouragement: A message need not be grand; one thoughtful sentence can travel far.
